dg-APL-207099.title: Red Sea Nutrients Control Pro Multi Test Kit (NO3/PO4)
dg-APL-207099.summary: High-accuracy color-comparator tests for nitrate and phosphate, the two nutrients reef keepers track to control algae and keep corals growing and colored.
rows: Color change read against the included color disk/card
inBox: NO3 reagents A (25 ml), B (20 g), C (20 g)
PO4 reagents A (50 ml), B (15 ml)
notes: Too much nitrate or phosphate feeds nuisance algae. Too little can hold back coral growth and color. Testing regularly lets you spot the trend.
